Introduction
1 Many have undertaken to draw up an account of the things that have been fulfilled[a] among us, 2 just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word. 3 With this in mind, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, I too decided to write an orderly account for you, most excellent __RECIPIENT_A__, 4 so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist Foretold
5 In the time of __RULER_A__ king of Judea there was a __WORKER_A__ named __PERSON_A__, who belonged to the __WORKER_A__ly division of __DIVISION_A__; his wife __PERSON_B__ was also a descendant of __FOREFATHER_B__. 6 Both of them were righteous in the sight of __MOST_HIGH_A__, observing all the __MASTER_A__ commands and decrees blamelessly. 7 But they were childless because __PERSON_B__ was not able to conceive, and they were both very old.

8 Once when __PERSON_A__ division was on duty and he was serving as __WORKER_A__ before __MOST_HIGH_A__, 9 he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the __WORKER_A__hood, to go into the __PLACE_A__ of the __MASTER_A__ and burn __MATERIAL_A__. 10 And when the time for the burning of __MATERIAL_A__ came, all the assembled worshipers were __REQUEST_A__ outside.

11 Then an __MESSENGER_A__ of the __MASTER_A__ appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of __MATERIAL_A__. 12 When __PERSON_A__ saw him, he was startled and was gripped with fear. 13 But the __MESSENGER_A__ said to him: “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_A__; your __REQUEST_A__ has been heard. Your wife __PERSON_B__ will bear you a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_C__. 14 He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth, 15 for he will be great in the sight of the __MASTER_A__. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ even before he is born. 16 He will bring back many of the people of __PEOPLE_A__ to the __MASTER_A__ their __MOST_HIGH_A__. 17 And he will go on before the __MASTER_A__, in the spirit and power of __PROPHET_A__, to turn the hearts of the parents to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the __MASTER_A__.”

18 __PERSON_A__ asked the __MESSENGER_A__, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years.”

19 The __MESSENGER_A__ said to him, “I am __MESSENGER_B__. I stand in the presence of __MOST_HIGH_A__, and I have been sent to speak to you and to tell you this good news. 20 And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their appointed time.”

21 Meanwhile, the people were waiting for __PERSON_A__ and wondering why he stayed so long in the __PLACE_A__. 22 When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the __PLACE_A__, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

23 When his time of service was completed, he returned home. 24 After this his wife __PERSON_B__ became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. 25 “The __MASTER_A__ has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”

The Birth of __PERSON_F__ Foretold
26 In the sixth month of __PERSON_B__ pregnancy, __MOST_HIGH_A__ sent the __MESSENGER_A__ __MESSENGER_B__ to __VILLAGE_A__, a town in __REGION_A__, 27 to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named __PERSON_E__, a descendant of __KING_A__. The virgin’s name was __PERSON_D__. 28 The __MESSENGER_A__ went to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The __MASTER_A__ is with you.”

29 __PERSON_D__ was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be. 30 But the __MESSENGER_A__ said to her, “Do not be afraid, __PERSON_D__; you have found favor with __MOST_HIGH_A__. 31 You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him __PERSON_F__. 32 He will be great and will be called the Son of the __HONORED_A__. The __MASTER_A__ __MOST_HIGH_A__ will give him the throne of his father __KING_A__, 33 and he will reign over __ANCESTOR_B__ descendants forever; his kingdom will never end.”

34 “How will this be,” __PERSON_D__ asked the __MESSENGER_A__, “since I am a virgin?”

35 The __MESSENGER_A__ answered, “The __SPIRIT_A__ will come on you, and the power of the __HONORED_A__ will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called[b] the Son of __MOST_HIGH_A__. 36 Even __PERSON_B__ your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be unable to conceive is in her sixth month. 37 For no word from __MOST_HIGH_A__ will ever fail.”

38 “I am the __MASTER_A__ servant,” __PERSON_D__ answered. “May your word to me be fulfilled.” Then the __MESSENGER_A__ left her.

__PERSON_D__ Visits __PERSON_B__
39 At that time __PERSON_D__ got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea, 40 where she entered __PERSON_A__ home and greeted __PERSON_B__. 41 When __PERSON_B__ heard __PERSON_D__ greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and __PERSON_B__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__. 42 In a loud voice she exclaimed: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear! 43 But why am I so favored, that the mother of my __MASTER_A__ should come to me? 44 As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy. 45 Blessed is she who has believed that the __MASTER_A__ would fulfill his promises to her!”

__PERSON_D__ Song
46 And __PERSON_D__ said:

“My soul glorifies the __MASTER_A__
47     and my spirit rejoices in __MOST_HIGH_A__ my Savior,
48 for he has been mindful
    of the humble state of his servant.
From now on all generations will call me blessed,
49     for the Mighty One has done great things for me—
    holy is his name.
50 His mercy extends to those who fear him,
    from generation to generation.
51 He has performed mighty deeds with his arm;
    he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.
52 He has brought down rulers from their thrones
    but has lifted up the humble.
53 He has filled the hungry with good things
    but has sent the rich away empty.
54 He has helped his servant __PEOPLE_A__,
    remembering to be merciful
55 to __ANCESTOR_A__ and his descendants forever,
    just as he promised our ancestors.”

56 __PERSON_D__ stayed with __PERSON_B__ for about three months and then returned home.

The Birth of __PERSON_C__ the Baptist
57 When it was time for __PERSON_B__ to have her baby, she gave birth to a son. 58 Her neighbors and relatives heard that the __MASTER_A__ had shown her great mercy, and they shared her joy.

59 On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father __PERSON_A__, 60 but his mother spoke up and said, “No! He is to be called __PERSON_C__.”

61 They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who has that name.”

62 Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child. 63 He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is __PERSON_C__.” 64 Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue set free, and he began to speak, praising __MOST_HIGH_A__. 65 All the neighbors were filled with awe, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things. 66 Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this child going to be?” For the __MASTER_A__ hand was with him.

__PERSON_A__ Song
67 His father __PERSON_A__ was filled with the __SPIRIT_A__ and prophesied:

68 “Praise be to the __MASTER_A__, the __MOST_HIGH_A__ of __PEOPLE_A__,
    because he has come to his people and redeemed them.
69 He has raised up a horn[c] of salvation for us
    in the house of his servant __KING_A__
70 (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),
71 salvation from our enemies
    and from the hand of all who hate us—
72 to show mercy to our ancestors
    and to remember his holy covenant,
73     the oath he swore to our father __ANCESTOR_A__:
74 to rescue us from the hand of our enemies,
    and to enable us to serve him without fear
75     in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

76 And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the __HONORED_A__;
    for you will go on before the __MASTER_A__ to prepare the way for him,
77 to give his people the knowledge of salvation
    through the forgiveness of their sins,
78 because of the tender mercy of our __MOST_HIGH_A__,
    by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
79 to shine on those living in darkness
    and in the shadow of death,
to guide our feet into the path of peace.”

80 And the child grew and became strong in spirit[d]; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to __PEOPLE_A__.
translations:
介绍
1 许多人已经着手整理在我们中间已经实现的事情的记载，2 就像那些从一开始就是目击者并且是道的仆人传给我们的那样。3 考虑到这一点，因为我自己从起初就仔细调查了一切，我也决定为你，最尊贵的 __RECIPIENT_A__，写一篇有序的叙述，4 这样你就可以知道你所受教导的事情的确实性。

施洗者 __PERSON_C__ 的诞生预告
5 在犹太王 __RULER_A__ 的时候，有一个名叫 __PERSON_A__ 的 __WORKER_A__，属于 __DIVISION_A__ 的 __WORKER_A__班次；他的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 也是 __FOREFATHER_B__ 的后代。6 他们在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前都是义人，无过失地遵守所有 __MASTER_A__ 的命令和律例。7 但他们没有孩子，因为 __PERSON_B__ 不能怀孕，而且他们已经很老了。

8 一次，当 __PERSON_A__ 的班次值勤时，他在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前服侍为 __WORKER_A__，9 按照 __WORKER_A__ 习俗用抽签方式，被选中进入 __MASTER_A__ 的 __PLACE_A__，焚烧 __MATERIAL_A__。10 焚烧 __MATERIAL_A__ 的时间到了，所有聚集的敬拜者都在外面等待。

11 然后 __MASTER_A__ 的一位 __MESSENGER_A__ 出现在他面前，站在 __MATERIAL_A__ 祭坛的右边。12 当 __PERSON_A__ 看到他时，惊恐并恐惧。13 但 __MESSENGER_A__ 对他说：“不要害怕，__PERSON_A__；你的 __REQUEST_A__ 已经被听见。你的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 将为你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫 __PERSON_C__。14 他将成为你的喜乐和喜悦，许多人因他的诞生而欢喜，15 因为他在 __MASTER_A__ 面前将会伟大。他不可喝酒或任何发酵的饮料，他将从胎中就被充满 __SPIRIT_A__。16 他将使许多 __PEOPLE_A__ 的子民归回他们的 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 主 __MASTER_A__。17 他将带着 __PROPHET_A__ 的灵和能力，走在 __MASTER_A__ 前面，使父母的心转向儿女，使悖逆的人归向义人的智慧，为 __MASTER_A__ 预备一个合适的百姓。”

18 __PERSON_A__ 问 __MESSENGER_A__：“我怎能确定这件事呢？我已经老了，我的妻子也年事已高。”

19 __MESSENGER_A__ 对他说：“我就是 __MESSENGER_B__。我站在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前，奉差遣向你说话，并告诉你这好消息。20 现在你要保持沉默，直到这一切发生的那一天，因为你不信我所说的话，这些话将在指定的时间应验。”

21 与此同时，人们等候 __PERSON_A__，奇怪他为什么在 __PLACE_A__ 里逗留那么长时间。22 他出来时无法与他们说话，他们知道他在 __PLACE_A__ 看见异象，因为他向他们做手势，但仍不能说话。

23 他值勤完毕，就回家了。24 后来，他的妻子 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕了，隐藏了五个月。25 她说：“这是 __MASTER_A__ 为我做的事，在这些日子里，他施恩给我，解除我在人前的羞辱。”

__PERSON_F__ 的诞生预告
26 在 __PERSON_B__ 怀孕的第六个月，__MOST_HIGH_A__ 差遣 __MESSENGER_A__ __MESSENGER_B__ 到 __REGION_A__ 的一个城镇 __VILLAGE_A__，27 去见一位名叫 __PERSON_D__ 的童贞女，她已许配给名叫 __PERSON_E__ 的人，是 __KING_A__ 的后代。童贞女名叫 __PERSON_D__。28 __MESSENGER_A__ 来到她那里，说：“蒙大恩的女子，你好！__MASTER_A__ 与你同在。”

29 __PERSON_D__ 对他的问候非常困惑，想知道这是什么意思。30 但 __MESSENGER_A__ 对她说：“不要害怕，__PERSON_D__；你在 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 面前蒙恩。31 你将怀孕生子，要给他起名叫 __PERSON_F__。32 他将为大，称为 __HONORED_A__ 的子。__MASTER_A__ __MOST_HIGH_A__ 将把他父亲 __KING_A__ 的宝座赐给他，33 他将永远治理 __ANCESTOR_B__ 的后裔，他的国永无穷尽。”

34 __PERSON_D__ 质问 __MESSENGER_A__：“我还是童女，怎能有这事呢？”

35 __MESSENGER_A__ 回答说：“__SPIRIT_A__ 要降临你，__HONORED_A__ 的能力要蔽庇你，所以将要生的圣者要称为 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的儿子。36 你的亲戚 __PERSON_B__ 也将在年老的时候怀孕，她那不育的人现在已怀孕六个月。37 因为 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的话绝不会落空。”

38 __PERSON_D__ 回答：“我是 __MASTER_A__ 的使女，愿你的话应验在我身上。”然后 __MESSENGER_A__ 离开她。

__PERSON_D__ 拜访 __PERSON_B__
39 当时 __PERSON_D__ 预备起来，急速往犹大山地的城镇去，40 进入 __PERSON_A__ 家，向 __PERSON_B__ 问安。41 __PERSON_B__ 听见 __PERSON_D__ 的问候时，胎儿在她腹中跳动，她被 __SPIRIT_A__ 充满。42 她大声呼喊：“妇女中你是有福的，你所怀的孩子也是有福的！43 我为什么蒙如此恩惠，主的母亲来拜访我呢？44 你问安的声音一入我耳，胎儿就在腹中跳跃欢喜。45 信主使他所应许的必定实现的，你是有福的！”

__PERSON_D__ 的歌
46 __PERSON_D__ 说：

“我的心尊主为大，
47 我的灵以我救主 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 快乐，
48 因他顾念他卑微的使女，
从今以后，万代要称我有福，
49 因为全能者为我成就了大事，
他的名为圣。
50 他怜悯敬畏他的人，
直到万代。
51 他用膀臂施展大能，
使骄傲的人心思散乱。
52 他叫有权势的跌落宝座，
却高举卑微的人。
53 他使饥饿的人得好食，
使富足的人空手而去。
54 他帮助他的仆人 __PEOPLE_A__，
55 记念他向祖先所立的慈爱约，
直到永远。”

56 __PERSON_D__ 住在 __PERSON_B__ 家约三个月，然后回家去了。

施洗者 __PERSON_C__ 的诞生
57 到了 __PERSON_B__ 生产的日子，她生了一个儿子。58 邻居和亲属听见 __MASTER_A__ 对她施恩，他们都和她一同喜乐。

59 第八天，他们来行割礼，打算以父亲 __PERSON_A__ 的名给孩子起名，60 但母亲反对，说：“不，他要叫 __PERSON_C__。”

61 他们说：“你亲属中没有这个名字。”

62 于是向父亲示意，问他想给孩子起什么名字。63 他要求一块写字板，写着：“他的名叫 __PERSON_C__。”这让众人都惊讶。64 立刻他张口，舌头解除禁锢，开始称颂 __MOST_HIGH_A__。65 殷勤的邻居们都充满敬畏，犹大山地的人们都谈论这事。66 凡听见的人都在思考：“这孩子将成为何等人？”因为 __MASTER_A__ 与他同在。

__PERSON_A__ 的赞歌
67 他父亲 __PERSON_A__ 被 __SPIRIT_A__ 充满，预言说：

68 “赞美 __MASTER_A__，是 __PEOPLE_A__ 的至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__，
69 因他来拯救他的百姓，
70 为我们兴起救恩的角，
71 在他仆人王 __KING_A__ 家里，
72 （正如古时圣先知所说）
73 拯救我们脱离仇敌和一切恨我们之人的手，
74 向我们的祖先发慈悲，记念他的圣约，
75 就是他向我们父亲 __ANCESTOR_A__ 所起的誓言：
76 要救我们脱离仇敌的手，
77 使我们虔诚无惧地事奉他，
78 在他面前，终身遵行圣洁正义。

79 而你，我的孩子，将被称为 __HONORED_A__ 的先知；
80 你要行在主 __MASTER_A__ 前，预备他的道路，
81 赐他的百姓罪得赦免，得救的知识，
82 因我们至高者 __MOST_HIGH_A__ 的怜悯，
83 从天而降的日头将照亮我们，
84 光照坐在黑暗中死荫下的人，
85 引导我们的脚走和平的路。”

80 孩子渐渐长大，灵力充足；他住在旷野，直到向 __PEOPLE_A__ 公开显现。
